newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB reiterates buy for Gotthard Bank.
newsitem.headline: CSFB reiterates buy for Gotthard Bank.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston reiterated its buy recommendation for shares of Gotthard Bank and forecast 20 percent annual earnings per share growth into the year 2000. The bank remains a takeover candidate, it said.
"Gotthard Bank has suffered greatly in the past few years from reserves for problem loans," which will remain high in 1997 and 1998, analyst Madeleine Hofmann wrote in a research note.
"Even on the basis of these abnormally low profits, Gotthard Bank has a discounted valuation in comparison with the sector that does not seem justified to this extent."
CSFB set a mid-1998 price target of 900 Swiss francs for shares, which closed yesterday at 793.
